pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark patches with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Patch geometry is predominantly star-shaped or jagged-polygonal across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways with variable pixel thickness, forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more pathways intersect.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge, contrasting against the light background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of approximately five parallel, vertical, hypopigmented linear scars are clearly visible on the mid-lateral flank, indicating significant physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian commensals (oxpeckers) stationed on the dorsal neck, posterior flank, and at the base of the tail.
